description: Figures the 2026 federal and state income tax on a household's short-term and long-term capital gains or losses given its other income: the tax the capital items add (ordinary-rate, long-term rate, net investment income tax and AMT parts), the long-term gain that still fits in the 0% band, the room before the net investment income tax, the capital loss deducted against other income and the carryover to 2027, and, given harvest_loss, the federal and state tax a harvested loss saves this year. Every figure is the difference of returns computed by QuantCalc's federal and state tax APIs, the engines the website's tax-loss harvesting calculator is checked against. Requires a connected QuantCalc PRO licence or Tax Season Pass; without one it returns no figures and names the free calculator. Not tax advice.

age.description: The age the filer reaches in 2026 (0-120). At 65 or more the age-65 standard deduction and the senior deduction apply. Default: under 65, stated in the result.

filing_status.description: 2026 filing status: single, married filing jointly (mfj), married filing separately (mfs) or head of household (hoh).

harvest_loss.description: A capital loss to realize in 2026 (tax-loss harvesting), as a positive amount: the result gives the federal and state tax it saves this year, the part deducted against other income and the carryover to 2027. Default: none.

harvest_loss_type.description: Whether harvest_loss is long_term (held more than one year) or short_term. Default long_term.

itemized_deductions.description: Total 2026 itemized deductions (Schedule A), when itemizing; the senior deduction is still added at 65 or more. Default: the standard deduction, stated in the result.

long_term_gain.description: 2026 net long-term capital gain (assets held more than one year), negative for a net loss. Default 0.

long_term_loss_carryover.description: Long-term capital loss carried over from 2025, as a positive amount. Default 0.

other_income.description: 2026 AGI without any capital gain or loss: wages, pensions, IRA withdrawals and other ordinary income, before the deduction. Taken as ordinary income that is not investment income. Default 0.

short_term_gain.description: 2026 net short-term capital gain (assets held one year or less), negative for a net loss. Default 0.

short_term_loss_carryover.description: Short-term capital loss carried over from 2025, as a positive amount. Default 0.

spouse_age.description: Joint return only: the age the spouse reaches in 2026. Default: the same as age, stated in the result.

state.description: Two-letter state of residence for all of 2026, or DC: adds the state tax on the capital items. Default: no state tax, stated in the result.

name: capital_gains_tax
title: 2026 capital gains tax, the 0% band and loss harvesting
